origins.section: 5.1 A Selector Names a Group, and the Group Runs Where the Selector Stands
5.2 The BIN Table Is Configuration, and the Most Specific Range Wins
5.3 A Name With No Group Behind It Runs Nothing
5.5 A Stock Participant Reports a Failure, and an Abort Participant Has to Answer It

gates.says: all 4 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-group-order: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-group-order: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-group-order: 5.1 says the TransactionManager puts the named group's participants into the chain right after the selector and carries on with the rest of the chain, and that several names run their groups 'in that order', which decides option a.
recorded.prompt:q-overlapping-bins: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-overlapping-bins: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-overlapping-bins: 5.2 says the range written with the most digits is tried first, whatever the order of the endpoint lines, and shows 411111 beating 4, which decides debit.
recorded.prompt:q-missing-group: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-missing-group: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-missing-group: 5.3 shows that a name with no group adds nothing, with no abort, and that the purchase is approved with 00 and leaves no log line when debug is off.
recorded.prompt:q-new-terminal-field: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-new-terminal-field: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-new-terminal-field: 5.5 says allow-extra-fields is false unless set so a field in neither list is an EXTRA_FIELD failure, and AnswerFailures.rcFor maps EXTRA_FIELD to 30, with field 12 given as the same terminal-update case.

gates.says: all 12 of this quiz's discriminating readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-group-order:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-group-order:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-group-order:b: 5.1 says the groups run in the order the selector names them, and its example group is declared at the end of the file but runs at the Switch; that file order doesn't matter takes a short inference.
recorded.prompt:q-group-order:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-group-order:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-group-order:c: 5.1 says outright that the group ran where Switch stands, before Approve, although the file declares it at the end.
recorded.prompt:q-group-order:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-group-order:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-group-order:d: 5.1 says the TransactionManager carries on with the rest of the chain after the group, and the contactless trail shows Approve running after the groups.
recorded.prompt:q-overlapping-bins:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-overlapping-bins:a: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-overlapping-bins:a: 5.2 says the ranges are tried by digit count 'whatever the order of the <endpoint> lines'.
recorded.prompt:q-overlapping-bins:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-overlapping-bins:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-overlapping-bins:c: The 5.2 deploy log lists the overlapping 411111 and 4 ranges as separate entries, and the onus card is routed by the narrower one; applying this to 457123 is a short inference.
recorded.prompt:q-overlapping-bins:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-overlapping-bins:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-overlapping-bins:d: 5.2 says line order doesn't matter and the most-digits range wins, so 'a later endpoint replaces' is refuted, even though debit is the right destination.
recorded.prompt:q-missing-group:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-missing-group:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-missing-group:b: 5.1 says Switch falls back to unknown only when the Context value has no property, and the 5.3 trail shows 'mastercad' selected with no fallback; this needs a short inference across the two sections.
recorded.prompt:q-missing-group:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-missing-group:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.prompt:q-missing-group:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-missing-group:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-missing-group:d: 5.3 says there is 'no exception, no abort', and the purchase is approved.
recorded.prompt:q-new-terminal-field:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-new-terminal-field:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-new-terminal-field:b: 5.5 says only named entries such as PCODE get a format check, and the 5.8 CheckFields table lists no named entry for field 37, so 37 is not a field CheckFields always format-checks.
recorded.prompt:q-new-terminal-field:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-new-terminal-field:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-new-terminal-field:c: 5.5 and the 5.8 CheckFields line state allow-extra-fields defaults to false, so a field in neither list fails rather than being let through.
recorded.prompt:q-new-terminal-field:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-new-terminal-field:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-new-terminal-field:d: 5.5 says a field in neither list is an EXTRA_FIELD failure, so CheckFields does look beyond the fields its lists name.

gates.says: each of the 4 questions keys exactly 1 of its distinct options and every option carries the sentence its reader is shown
each of the 4 questions cites a passage the ledger still digests to the value this exercise was built from
